Vision Government Solutions

|

GLASTONBURY, CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to The Town of
Glastonbury, Connecticut, Assessor’s Online Assessment Database

This database provides you with information on each
parcel of real estate in Glastonbury, along with the ability to search for
sales of properties that might be similar to your selected property.

Glastonbury is performing a revaluation for the Grand List of October 1, 2022.
This revaluation will impact the tax bills due July 2023. The Town of Glastonbury
and Vision Government Solutions are working on the revaluation at this time.

Do not apply the current mill rate to
your new assessment, as the mill rate will change. Using the prior mill rate
will not estimate your July 2023 tax bill. The Town will set a new mill
rate in Spring 2023 .

In conjunction with the 2022 revaluation assessment notices, you may review
your new assessment with a representative of Vision Government Solutions by
scheduling an informal hearing. Informal hearings will be held by PHONE by
appointment only. You must book your appointment by December 9,
2022.

To schedule an informal hearing, you may go to www.vgsi.com/schedules [http://www.vgsi.com/schedules] and follow the instructions to schedule an informal
hearing. You will need the Parcel ID number ( PID# ), which can be found at the top of the 2022 revaluation
assessment notice or in the online database. If you wish to schedule an
informal hearing for two or more properties, do not schedule your hearings
online, please call Vision Government Solutions at 1-888-844-4300. If
you do not have access to a computer, or prefer to call for an appointment time
instead of scheduling your informal hearing online, you may call 1-888-844-4300
between the hours of 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday, excluding
state holidays.

DO NOT contact the Town of Glastonbury Assessor’s Office
to schedule your informal hearing with Vision Government Solutions. Town staff does not have access to create,
change, or cancel hearing appointments.

I f you wish to appeal your assessment
after the informal hearing process is complete, you must file a written appeal
to the Glastonbury Board of Assessment Appeals on the prescribed appeal
application which can be found on the Property Assessment page of the Town’s
website after January 25, 2023. The forms will also be available in the
Assessor’s Office at the Glastonbury Town Hall after that date. Appeal
applications must be received on or before February 17 th ,
2023.

You may be prompted to install Silverlight (a free product from Microsoft) after you enter. Follow all the prompts to run the plug-in installer. In some cases, you may need to refresh or restart your browser. If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
